text: A psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.
O God, you are my God; I seek you at dawn. My soul thirsts for you, my body longs for you, in a dry and weary land where there is no water.

versions.text: God, you are my God; I seek you at dawn. My soul thirsts for you, my body longs for you, in a dry and weary land where there is no water.
versions.explanation: For oral reading, the bare opening "God, you are my God" is abrupt and can sound like a statement about a third party. The vocative particle "O" gives the line the address-like rhythm the Hebrew opening carries and improves the flow when read aloud.

text: So I have gazed on you in the sanctuary, to see your power and your glory.
Because your steadfast love is better than life, my lips will praise you.
So I will bless you as long as I live; in your name I will lift up my hands.
My soul will be satisfied as with the richest of food, and with joyful lips my mouth will praise you.

versions.text: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of food, and my mouth praises you with joyful lips.
versions.explanation: Both Hebrew verbs are imperfect and follow the vow of verse 5 ("I will bless you"), so future forms keep the sequence consistent. Placing "with joyful lips" before the verb also mirrors the Hebrew word order and gives the line a smoother cadence for reading aloud.

text: When I remember you on my bed, I think of you through the watches of the night.
For you have been my help, and in the shadow of your wings I will sing for joy.

versions.text: For you have been my help, and in the shadow of your wings I sing for joy.
versions.explanation: The verb is imperfect and parallels the other forward-looking vows in the psalm (verses 5-6); "I will sing for joy" keeps the tense pattern consistent across the section.

text: My soul clings to you; your right hand upholds me.
But those who seek my life to destroy it will go down to the depths of the earth.
They will be handed over to the sword; they will become food for jackals.
But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be silenced.
